IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO. 3370 OF 2024
Rutik Nagesh Landge … Applicant
vs.
The State of Maharashtra and another … Respondents
Mr. Shirish Gupte, Senior Advocate, a/w. Mr. Pandit Kasar an d Mr. Sagar
Bhosale for applicant.
Mr. H. S. Venegaonkar, Public Prosecutor, a/w. Mr. Tanveer G. Khan, APP
for respondent No.1-State.
Mr. Sachin Hire, ACP .
       CORAM :  MANISH PITALE, J.
DATE     : 13th DECEMBER, 2024
P.C. :
. Heard learned senior counsel for the applicant and the learned
Public Prosecutor for the respondent No.1-State.
2. This Court is informed that the Sessions Court granted interim
protection to the applicant till 17.12.2024.
3. The learned  Public  Prosecutor  submits  that  before  the  said
date, the respondent-State will file an affidavit alongwith documents,
to  show  the  conduct  of  the  applicant,  even  after  registration  of
offence and as to the manner in which he is seeking to influence the
informant and obstruct the process of fair investigation.
4. Reply affidavit be filed on or before 16.12.2024.
5. List on 17.12.2024, to be included in the supplementary list.
(MANISH PITALE, J)
